_meta.description: M&A status registry for watchlist tickers. Drives ACQ/BID/RUMOR pills + deal blurbs in drilldown popup, replacing the earnings note slot. Only tickers with verified Tier-1 sourcing (SEC filings, issuer press releases) reach status='closed' or 'pending'. Rumors require 4 gates (see schema).
rumor_gates: Story names specific buyer or transaction
Story published before or coincident with the move

pending_review.headline: BILL Holdings surged after Bloomberg reported Hellman & Friedman was in talks to acquire the company
pending_review.rationale: A Tier-1 Bloomberg-reported rumor named a specific buyer, Hellman & Friedman, and described acquisition talks for BILL Holdings. The report was published on Friday and the stock move occurred in the same session, so the timing gate is satisfied based on the provided results. The only limitation is that the search results do not include the original Bloomberg page itself, but the secondary coverage consistently attributes the story to Bloomberg.

pending_review.headline: Bloomberg reported Autodesk is considering a cash-and-stock acquisition of PTC
pending_review.rationale: Gate 1 is satisfied because the prompt already verifies ADSK moved -3.10%. Gate 2 is satisfied by a Tier-1 Bloomberg report referenced in the market coverage, and Gate 3 is satisfied because the story names a specific buyer, Autodesk, and a specific target, PTC. Gate 4 is satisfied because the coverage ties the price move to the Bloomberg report as an immediate reaction, with no evidence the story was published after the move.

pending_review.headline: Bloomberg-reported exploration of a deal for Barrick's Nevada gold assets triggered a move in Newmont and Barrick
pending_review.rationale: A Tier-1 Bloomberg report says Newmont is exploring a potential transaction to acquire Barrick's Nevada gold mining assets, which names a specific buyer and specific asset transaction. The story is the kind of strategic M&A speculation covered by the screen, and it was reported within the last 24 hours based on the provided results; however, the source details available here are indirect via a secondary article, so confidence is not perfect. The timing gate is satisfied because the report appears to precede the session move rather than follow it.

CFLT.strategic_rationale: Acquires Kafka franchise as the real-time data backbone for IBM's enterprise AI/agent platform. Confluent slots beside Red Hat in IBM Software, giving IBM control of streaming infrastructure underneath gen-AI workloads.
pros: All-cash deal at $31/share — clean exit, no IBM equity risk
Buyer is investment-grade — closing risk near zero post-announce
cons: Locks Confluent into IBM's GTM motion; cloud-native customers may slow Kafka spend pending integration clarity
Loss of pure-play streaming public comp removes a key data-infrastructure reference

competitor_impact.note: Azure Event Hubs sees less competitive pressure from a hyperscaler-neutral Confluent; modest tailwind
Loses an independent partner; Snowflake-Confluent integrations now run through IBM's roadmap priorities
Observability of Kafka streams becomes more strategic as IBM consolidates the layer
